label_origin: Assistant-authored from original PDF tables rendered and checked on 2026-10-31; no independent human adjudicator. Fixed retrieval/parser from 4eff99a; labels committed before first scoring. Exposed for retrieval tuning after the original 200-case measurement; no longer an independent test. Original questions/labels unchanged.

protocol.design: Four new companies x 50 questions: 22 statement + 8 note + 8 prior-column + 8 multi-value + 4 year-comparison. 120 distinct company/metric rows; cases share source pages and targets.
protocol.source_policy: Complete 2024 consolidated reports, official issuer PDFs, 427 pages; no gold-page filtering. GMD audited financial statements, other three annual reports. Source choice by size/accessibility/labelability before scores.
protocol.question_policy: Structured Vietnamese question templates over distinct reviewed rows; not sampled production conversations. Multi-value/comparison cases deliberately reuse scalar targets, not independent observations.
protocol.metric_policy: Existing top-5 chunk page-reference recall/MRR and strict literal anchor coverage unchanged. Original PDF visual labels missing in parsed text remain in denominator and score zero for missing anchors.
protocol.answer_policy: VND integers with original printed signs; 2023 balance answers use opening 01/01/2024 column. Retrieval only, no arithmetic or generation accuracy evaluated.
